calls.statement:
SELECT DISTINCT fiscal_year, fiscal_period, fiscal_period_label, period_start_date, period_end_date 
FROM ref_fiscal_calendar 
WHERE fiscal_period = 2 
ORDER BY fiscal_year DESC

SELECT 
    ds.format as store_format,
    COUNT(DISTINCT fsl.receipt_id) as total_receipts,
    SUM(fsl.quantity) as units_sold,
    SUM(frl.quantity_returned) as units_returned,
    ROUND(100.0 * SUM(COALESCE(frl.quantity_returned, 0)) / SUM(fsl.quantity), 2) as return_rate_pct
FROM fact_sales_line fsl
INNER JOIN dim_store ds ON fsl.store_key = ds.store_key
LEFT JOIN fact_return_line frl ON fsl.sales_line_id = frl.sales_line_id
WHERE fsl.sale_date BETWEEN '2025-05-26' AND '2025-06-22'
GROUP BY ds.format
ORDER BY ds.format

SELECT sales_line_id, COUNT(*) as return_count
FROM fact_return_line
WHERE return_date BETWEEN '2025-05-26' AND '2025-06-22'
GROUP BY sales_line_id
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
LIMIT 10

SELECT 
    ds.format,
    ds.store_id,
    ds.store_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT fsl.sales_line_id) as sales_lines,
    SUM(fsl.quantity) as units_sold,
    COUNT(DISTINCT frl.return_line_id) as return_lines,
    SUM(COALESCE(frl.quantity_returned, 0)) as units_returned
FROM fact_sales_line fsl
INNER JOIN dim_store ds ON fsl.store_key = ds.store_key
LEFT JOIN fact_return_line frl ON fsl.sales_line_id = frl.sales_line_id
WHERE fsl.sale_date BETWEEN '2025-05-26' AND '2025-06-22'
GROUP BY ds.format, ds.store_id, ds.store_name
ORDER BY ds.format, ds.store_id
